identity: An office editing workspace with a slide deck, shape formatting tools, a document, anchored comments, and revision controls.

scenarios.name: reorder
scenarios.screen: A rail holds six slide thumbnails in their starting order, and the active slide appears in the slide canvas. No thumbnail is being dragged.
never: A thumbnail floating under the pointer on load
Slides already outside the thumbnail rail
An empty deck
More slide thumbnails than the deck contains

arrangements.text: The thumbnail rail runs down the left of the slide canvas.
The thumbnail rail runs beneath the slide canvas.

scenarios.name: align
scenarios.screen: The slide canvas shows four labelled shapes at their starting positions, with the outer shapes at opposite horizontal ends. Alignment and distribution controls are visible; no alignment menu is open.
never: The four shapes already evenly distributed at the requested vertical position
A shape outside the slide canvas
An alignment menu open on load
A fifth shape added to the slide

arrangements.text: Alignment and distribution controls sit above the slide canvas, which holds the four shapes in one working area.
Alignment and distribution controls sit to the right of the slide canvas, which holds the four shapes in one working area.

scenarios.name: restyle
scenarios.screen: The slide canvas shows labelled text shapes with their starting formatting. Bold, italic, text colour, and point-size controls are visible; the colour picker is closed.
never: The requested text shape already shown with the complete target formatting
A colour picker open on load
A point-size menu open on load
A separate text box for editing the shape's wording

arrangements.text: The formatting controls run above the slide canvas, and the labelled shapes sit inside the canvas.
The formatting controls form a column beside the slide canvas, and the labelled shapes sit inside the canvas.

scenarios.name: comments
scenarios.screen: The document shows its paragraphs and the phrase that can receive a comment. No text is selected, and the comment composer is closed with an empty draft.
never: The target phrase selected on load
The comment composer open on load
The requested comment already posted
A free-floating comment with no document anchor

arrangements.text: The document occupies the main reading area, with anchored comments beside the relevant text.
The document sits above an anchored comment list, with each entry tied to a phrase in the document.

scenarios.name: trackchanges
scenarios.screen: The document shows proposed text changes, and a review list presents each change with Accept and Reject controls. The revisions start pending.
never: The named revisions already accepted or rejected
A revision being dragged
A comment composer open on load
A review entry with no corresponding document change

arrangements.text: The document sits to the left of a review list containing the revisions and their action controls.
The document sits above a review list containing the revisions and their action controls.
